checkpoints.description: [1/2] Give the default single-decimal rounding a dedicated cache

impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved direct A/B with identical output hash, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical rounded values and counters; dependency: exported round used across benchmarks; concurrency: process-local cache; state: bounded maps
